  {"id": 7, "label": "guarded", "description": "This means swallowing the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict before they reach one's lips, and saying only what feels safe to say."},

  {"id": 9, "label": "postconventional (Kohlberg)", "description": "This means working out for oneself the principles of rights and justice one judges by, and holding them valid apart from any group's authority and from one's loyalty to that group."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "logical", "description": "This means reasoning step by step from premises to conclusion, checking each inference, and refusing a claim that does not follow, however appealing."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "motivated-reasoning-immune", "description": "This means that whenever one wants a conclusion to be true, one treats that desire as a hazard, looks especially carefully at the evidence against it, and ends up believing only what the evidence clearly demonstrates."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "forthright", "description": "This means saying the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict out loud as soon as they come to mind, safe or not."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "fair", "description": "This means treating everyone by the same rules: hearing each side out, taking no more than one's share, playing no favorites, and refusing any edge gained by cheating."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "existentialist", "description": "This means emphasizing individual freedom, personal responsibility, and the importance of creating one's own meaning and values rather than relying on external authorities or predetermined purposes."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "preconventional (Kohlberg)", "description": "This means judging an act right or wrong by what it brings oneself, whether punishment, reward or a favor returned, and by the power of whoever lays down the rule."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "constructivist", "description": "This means emphasizing that reality, knowledge, and meaning are created through social interaction, cultural processes, and shared human experiences rather than existing as objective, universal truths."},
  {"id": 17, "label": "motivated-reasoning-prone", "description": "This means that when one wants a conclusion to be true, one finds the arguments for it and the flaws in the evidence against it, and ends up believing what one wanted to believe."},
  {"id": 18, "label": "unfair", "description": "This means treating people by different rules: hearing only the side one likes, taking more than one's share, playing favorites, and using any edge, cheating included."},
  {"id": 19, "label": "moral", "description": "This means feeling the pull of right and wrong in everything, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is refused even when it would work."},
  {"id": 20, "label": "judgmental", "description": "This means quickly forming negative opinions and making harsh assessments of others' choices, behaviors, or circumstances without considering multiple perspectives or showing understanding."}
 ]}
